title: Cajun Chicken Rainbow Rice
description: Chicken, peppers, onion and celery simmered with rice, Cajun seasoning and sweetcorn in one pan.
steps: In a sauté pan with a lid, fry onion and celery in cooking spray for 5 minutes. Add chicken, peppers and Cajun spice mix; stir-fry 5 minutes.
Stir in rice; pour in hot stock; add sweetcorn and mix. Lid on; simmer 12 minutes.
Remove lid; fluff rice with a fork; simmer 2–3 more minutes to steam off remaining liquid.
Check rice is tender; serve sprinkled with pepper and parsley.
notes: Use frozen pre-cut onion, peppers and diced chicken to save prep time.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
